data.name: Tata Textile Mills Limited
data.description: Tata Textile Mills Limited is a public limited company incorporated in Pakistan on April 15, 1987 under the Companies Ordinance, 1984 (repealed by The Companies' Act 2017). The principal activity of the Company is manufacturing and sale of yarn.
